headline_pain: Dead Money Is Killing Your Biz
primary_text: "I'm paying more in rent every year and getting nothing to show for it. Dead money." Over 120 small businesses in Melbourne's west have already made the switch from renting to owning. They locked in off-the-plan warehouse pricing in Truganina and turned their biggest overhead into their biggest asset. These purpose-built units sit minutes from Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and the Port of Melbourne. Designed for owner-occupiers who need the right size without paying for space they don't use. Don't be the last one still renting.
description: Join 120+ businesses who stopped renting and bought their own warehouse in Truganina.
